cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Count What I Did
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the practical work, time, or inconvenience you contributed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I spent my Saturday fixing your fence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Three panels, eighteen screws, two shops and one blister.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll recommend you to next door. They've got six panels.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell them three took my whole Saturday before you make me sound available for Sunday.

mechanism: A corrects a pupil narrow estimate of fence work and makes its recommendation include the actual time cost.
confusable: A seeks acknowledgment of labor, not more jobs or payment for a new commission.
comparison: Counting exertion for public rest versus bounding a recommendation with actual time.
seedUse: Keep D33 panels/screws/shops/blister/neighbor offer; S05 estimate-training turns minimized work into a corrected account.
